Welcome! My name is Casey.

People science · Organizational analytics · Research design

I am a People Scientist who helps organizations enhance employee well-being through quantitative analysis of workplace dynamics and company policies.

I design studies, analyze employee experience data, and build reproducible research workflows that connect evidence to action using a variety of methods including, survey experiments, longitudinal methods, statistical modeling, text analysis, and qualitative research.

When Workplace Solidarity Breaks Down

How DEI Backtracking Harms Trust

Multi-study project testing how people interpret symbolic versus substantive DEI action, organizational backtracking, and credibility when companies change course.

When Dialogue Does Not Persuade Symmetrically
